ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:3 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (dark) pixels; high-intensity pixels are localized to the lateral lobe regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two distinct high-contrast white blobs on distal lobes; left lobe contains a triangular white patch; right lobe contains a larger, more rectangular white patch with internal low-intensity linear streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate angle of 105 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations; right lobe distal edge displays high-amplitude jagged peaks and deep valleys; left lobe trailing edge displays lower-amplitude, more uniform serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal sweep; convex curvature originating from the median notch transitioning to concave trajectories towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparse distribution of small, circular high-intensity pixel clusters on the dark medial regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions traversing the white pigmentation zone on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular jaggedness and potential tissue loss on the far right distal tip of the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique branching dark pigmentation pattern embedded within the white high-intensity zone of the right lobe.
